title: Bug: XCVR device gets re-instantiated when port_name_sysfs does not exist
author: michaelc-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

This is caused by a bug in pddfparse.py. The logic that creates the xcvr eeprom wants to conditionally run another cmd if the `port_name_sysfs` path exists. However, the current logic will rerun the previous `cmd` if `port_name_sysfs` does not exist. This results in a device re-instantiation error.

### Steps to Reproduce

Create a XCVR eeprom device in PDDF that does not have a port_name_sysfs

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual Behavior: `i2c i2c-97: Failed to register i2c client optoe2 at 0x50 (-16)`
Expected Behavior: No error message
